Panel.Title: Talking Tokens
Panel.TokenPlaceholder: Paste the token from the Discord Developer Portal
Panel.TokenSaved: Token saved. The bridge keeps it on this computer; Foundry does not store it.
Panel.WhoAreYou: Who are you? Click your own name.
Panel.JoinVoiceFirst: Join a voice channel in Discord. Your name then shows here.
Panel.AutoConnect: Connect to Discord when the world loads
Panel.StartPlacement: Drag to place on the selected token
Panel.PlacementActive: Drag the bubble on {token}, then save.
Panel.SelectTokenFirst: Select a token on the canvas first.
Panel.VoiceSummary: {linked} of {total} people in the channel are linked to a Foundry user.
Panel.NotLinkedNames: Not linked, so their voice shows on no token: {names}.
Panel.NoSpeakerToken: no speaking token in this scene
Panel.SetupNeedsBridge: Start the bridge first: double-click talking-tokens-bridge.exe on this computer. The bot setup then shows here.
Panel.SetupNeedsNewBridge: This bridge does not match the module version. Download the new bridge, close the old bridge window, and start the new one.
Panel.SetupNeedsLocalhost: The bot setup works only when Foundry is open on this computer through localhost.
Panel.PickDefaultBubble: Click a bubble to use it on all tokens. Add your own images with +.
Panel.AddBubble: Add an image to the bubbles
Panel.SelectTokenForBubble: Select a token to give it its own bubble.
Panel.Test: Show a test bubble for {name} for 3 seconds

Hud.Mark: My voice shows on this token
Hud.Unmark: Stop showing my voice on this token

Status.not-localhost: Open Foundry on this computer through localhost (for example http://localhost:30000) to use Talking Tokens.
Status.connecting: Looking for the Talking Tokens bridge…
Status.bridge-not-found: The Talking Tokens bridge is not running on this computer. Start talking-tokens-bridge.exe with a double-click; this panel then connects by itself. If you do not have the program yet, download it.
Status.incompatible: The bridge is version {bridge}. This module needs the bridge of version {module}. Download it, close the old bridge window, and start the new bridge.
Status.no-token: Paste your Discord bot token to finish the setup.
Status.token-rejected: Discord rejected the bot token. Copy it again from the Discord Developer Portal.
Status.discord-unreachable: Discord cannot be reached. Check the internet connection.
Status.no-server: The bot is in no Discord server. Invite it to your server.
Status.no-gm: Join a voice channel, then click your own name under Bot setup.
Status.gm-not-in-voice: Waiting for you to join a voice channel.
Status.missing-permission: The bot cannot join #{channel}. In Discord, give the bot the View Channel and Connect permissions on that channel. The bot then joins by itself.
Status.reconnecting: The connection to Discord dropped. Reconnecting… If this stays, check the internet connection.

Action.invite: Invite the bot to a server

TokenError.token-rejected: Discord rejected this token. Copy it again from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot → Reset Token).
TokenError.discord-unreachable: Discord cannot be reached, so the token was not checked. Try again.

Notifications.ImageFailed: The image {path} could not be loaded. The classic bubble shows instead.
Notifications.MarkFailed: The speaking token could not be changed.
Notifications.DiagnosticsCopied: The diagnostics are on the clipboard. Paste them into your bug report.
Notifications.DiagnosticsFailed: The diagnostics could not be copied to the clipboard.

holdTimeMs.Name: Hold time (ms)
holdTimeMs.Hint: How long the bubble stays after the player stops speaking. This stops flicker between words.

showIndicators.Name: Show speech bubbles
showIndicators.Hint: Turn off to hide all speech bubbles on this computer only.

Hotkey.Name: Speak as the hovered token
Hotkey.Hint: Point at one of your tokens and press the key. Your voice then shows on that token in this scene.
